title: SAT Statistics: Mean, Median, Spread, and Margin of Error
description:
SAT statistics questions are less about calculating and more about knowing what the numbers mean. This lesson covers center, spread, margin of error, and study design, then works through 6 SAT-style practice questions that get harder as they go.

You'll learn:
• How an outlier affects the mean vs. the median
• Range vs. standard deviation, and how to compare spread without calculating
• The "switch to totals" trick for combined and changed means
• What a margin of error does (and doesn't) tell you
• Random sampling vs. random assignment, and what observational studies can't prove
• A test-day framework for any statistics question

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. All data in this video is illustrative (made up for practice). For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Problem-Solving and Data Analysis).
